---
title: "Data Dictionary"
subtitle: "Sources, indicators, coverage, and limitations"
---

The analysis combines international tourism and economic indicators for small island developing states (SIDS). Sources differ in definitions, coverage, and reporting periods; the indicators are not interchangeable.

Raw source files are retained in `data/raw/`, processed datasets in `data/processed/`, and retrieval metadata alongside the source files.

## Tourism Indicators

| Source | Indicator | Variable | Unit | Coverage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Our World in Data (OWID) | International visitor spending | `visitor_spend_gdp_pct` | % GDP | 1995–2024 |
| World Bank WDI | International tourism receipts (`ST.INT.RCPT.XP.ZS`) | `tourism_receipts_pct_exports` | % exports | Approximately 1995–2020 |

OWID visitor spending is the primary exposure indicator. It measures spending by international visitors in the destination economy, including accommodation, food, transport, entertainment, shopping, and fares paid to domestic airlines. Its underlying sources include UN Tourism, national statistical organizations and central banks, OECD national accounts, and World Bank estimates.

WDI tourism receipts measure payments by international visitors relative to exports of goods and services. Fourteen of the 35 economies in the WDI shock sample lack a 2019 observation; their 2017–2019 baselines use 2017 and 2018 only.

Both indicators are exposure proxies, not direct measures of tourism value added.

## Economic Indicators

Source: [World Bank, World Development Indicators](https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators).

| Indicator | WDI code | Variable | Unit | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GDP growth | `NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG` | `gdp_growth_pct` | Annual % | 2020 economic shock |
| Real GDP | `NY.GDP.MKTP.KD` | `gdp_real_const2015usd` | Constant 2015 USD | Aggregate recovery |
| Real GDP per capita | `NY.GDP.PCAP.KD` | `gdppc_real_const2015usd` | Constant 2015 USD/person | Per-capita recovery |

GDP growth measures annual changes in real output. GDP and GDP per capita are indexed independently to 2019 = 100 for recovery comparisons.

GDP data cover 2015–2025. Within the 29-economy recovery sample, coverage falls from 29 economies through 2022 to 28 in 2023–2024 and 22 in 2025. The 2025 observations are preliminary.

## Candidate Universe

Based on the [UN-OHRLLS SIDS list](https://www.un.org/ohrlls/content/list-sids).

| Classification | Economies |
|---|---:|
| OHRLLS-listed SIDS | 39 |
| Associate Member SIDS | 18 |
| Additional island economy (BES) | 1 |
| **Candidate universe** | **58** |

The universe includes Cook Islands and Niue, both listed by OHRLLS despite not being UN General Assembly members. Associate members are primarily non-sovereign territories. Bahrain is excluded because it is no longer classified as a UN SIDS.

Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, and Saba (BES) are included for regional completeness but have no observations in the retrieved sources.

## Processed Datasets

Repository location: `data/processed/`.

| File | Structure | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `candidates.csv` | 58 economies | Candidate universe and classification |
| `country_coverage.csv` | 58 economies | Source coverage and analytical sample flags |
| `baseline_shock_recovery.csv` | 57 economies | Tourism baselines, observation counts, economic outcomes, and sample flags |
| `analytical_panel.csv` | 1,707 economy-year observations | Long-format, unbalanced panel, 1995–2025 |
| `recovery_index.csv` | Economy-year observations | Indexed real GDP and GDP per capita |

The analytical panel combines available OWID and WDI observations. Coverage varies by indicator, economy, and year; missing values are retained. BES is absent.

`baseline_shock_recovery.csv` contains both 2015–2019 and 2017–2019 tourism means and the number of annual observations contributing to each.

`recovery_index.csv` contains `gdp_index` and `gdppc_index`, each referenced to 2019 = 100.

## Raw Data and Coverage

**World Bank:** `data/raw/worldbank/wdi_tourism_covid.csv` contains observations retrieved through `wbstats::wb_data()` in November 2026. The API returned 51 economies; AIA, GLP, MTQ, MSR, BES, COK, and NIU were not recognized.

Retrieval details are recorded in `data/raw/worldbank/wdi_retrieval_metadata.txt`.

**Our World in Data:** Visitor-spending CSV files are stored under `data/raw/spending-by-international-visitors-while-visiting-a-country-as-a-share-of-gdp/`. These are fixed 2026 downloads and do not update automatically.

The two tourism indicators have different denominators and coverage. Their common shock sample contains 24 economies. Missing observations do not represent zero tourism or economic activity.

## Sources

- [UN-OHRLLS — List of SIDS](https://www.un.org/ohrlls/content/list-sids)
- [World Bank — World Development Indicators](https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators)
- [Our World in Data — Tourism](https://ourworldindata.org/tourism)
- [UN Tourism — Statistics](https://www.unwto.org/tourism-statistics)

Source availability reflects the November 2026 retrieval. National reporting differences, territorial coverage, and subsequent source revisions may affect comparability.
